title: ProtoCAM: Interpretable Few-Shot Mask-Guided Prototypical Learning for Breast Lesion Classification in Ultrasound Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2609.13340v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Breast ultrasound imaging plays an important role in the early detection and diagnosis of breast cancer, particularly for patients with dense breast tissue. However, developing reliable deep learning models for ultrasound analysis is challenging due to limited annotated medical data and the need for interpretable predictions. To address these challenges, this paper proposes ProtoCAM, an explainable few-shot learning framework for breast lesion classification that integrates mask-guided feature encoding, prototypical metric learning, and gradient-based visual explanations. The proposed approach leverages lesion masks to guide feature extraction and constructs class prototypes within an embedding space to enable robust classification under limited training samples. translated_abstract: 乳腺超声成像在乳腺癌的早期检测和诊断中发挥着重要作用，尤其对于乳腺组织致密的患者。然而，由于标注医学数据有限以及对可解释预测的需求，开发可靠的超声分析深度学习模型极具挑战性。为应对这些挑战，本文提出了ProtoCAM，一个用于乳腺病变分类的可解释少样本学习框架，该框架集成了掩码引导的特征编码、原型度量学习以及基于梯度的视觉解释。所提出的方法利用病变掩码引导特征提取，并在嵌入空间中构建类别原型，从而在有限训练样本下实现鲁棒的分类。该框架在BUSI数据集上采用分层组k折交叉验证协议进行评估，以防止患者级别的数据泄露。实验结果表明……
tldr: 本文提出ProtoCAM框架，将掩码引导特征编码与原型度量学习相结合，在少量标注样本条件下实现了乳腺超声病变的可解释分类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ProtoCAM, an interpretable few-shot learning framework that combines mask-guided feature encoding with prototypical metric learning to achieve explainable breast lesion classification in ultrasound imaging under limited annotated data.
